statement.name: GetComponentConfigItems
statement.sql: SELECT cc.lookupcode as componentconfigtypecode , componenttypecode , componentname , cc.resourcetypecode , configxml FROM lu_pfm_componentconfig cc JOIN LU_PFM_ComponentType ct ON ct.lookupcode = cc.componenttypecode;

statement.name: GetComponentConfigItemsFiltered
statement.sql: SELECT cc.lookupcode as componentconfigtypecode , componenttypecode , componentname , cc.resourcetypecode , configxml FROM lu_pfm_componentconfig cc JOIN LU_PFM_ComponentType ct ON ct.lookupcode = cc.componenttypecode

statement.name: GetComponentConfigItem
statement.sql:
SELECT cc.lookupcode as componentconfigtypecode , componenttypecode , componentname , cc.resourcetypecode , configxml FROM LU_PFM_ComponentConfig CC INNER JOIN LU_PFM_ComponentType CT ON CC.ComponentTypeCode=CT.LookupCode INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_CONT_Resources Res On Res.ResourceTypeCode = CC.ResourceTypeCode INNER JOIN dbo.PFM_CONT_Invitation Inv ON Res.ResourceID=Inv.ResourceId
1
